error_analysis.key_error_regime: Misclassifications cluster heavily around sudden market volatility shocks and macro news events when technical indicators experience lag.

final_model_selection.justification: Random Forest achieved the best risk-adjusted test performance (F1-score, Directional Accuracy, and highest Sharpe ratio in strategy backtesting). Unlike deep recurrent architectures, it demonstrates robustness against regime shifts, resists overfitting on small daily financial samples, requires sub-millisecond scoring latency (<5ms), and provides transparent feature importances.
